name: Domain Access Entity Type
description: Control entity types domain access (list builders and menus).
project_description: This module gives the possibility to manage access to an entity type by domain (for example if we want to make a certain content type available only in one domain). This module doesn't manage content access, however if you want to manage content access by domain, you could use https://www.drupal.org/project/domain_entity . It requires the Domain (domain) contrib module and ships the det_node submodule (enabled automatically) which adds per-domain access control for node/content types.
